resources.string: Watches for stingray signatures: RAT downgrade (4G/5G → 2G), LAC/TAC jumps, signal surges. No root needed — reads the live modem. Alerts are heuristic, not proof.
Listens on a high port (no root). Classifies first packets: SSH probes, HTTP exploit paths, CGI scans, brute attempts. For authorized networks only.
PackageManager-level risk audit: dangerous permissions, exported components, cleartext traffic, debuggable flag, low targetSdk. No root.
Honest boundary: phones cannot enter monitor mode — this audits security posture only (encryption, WPS exposure, risk score). Cracking requires aircrack-ng on a supported adapter.
BLE broadcast chat — no pairing, no internet. Short range (~30 m), open channel: treat as public.
Aggregates all subscribed security feeds (CVE, advisories, news, world) into one reading stream. Offline cache included.
Phones cannot inject as a Bluetooth keyboard (CVE-2023-45866 needs Linux/ESP32). This lab generates and validates DuckyScript payload files for BlueDucky / Flipper BadUSB hardware.
Seek truth from facts 实事求是
Base every decision on investigated reality, not assumptions. No investigation, no right to speak.
Find the principal contradiction and its principal aspect — solve that first; the rest follows.
Knowledge comes from action and is validated only by action. Iterate: act, observe, correct.
Hold total confidence in the long game while preparing every detail with maximum seriousness.
Concentrate superior force 集中优势兵力
Never fight evenly everywhere. Concentrate overwhelming resources on the weakest point, destroy it, move on.
Protracted war in stages 持久战
Long conflicts are won in phases. Do not trade the campaign for one battle; time is a weapon.
Unite the many against the few: win over neutrals, isolate the main opponent, never fight all enemies at once.
First-hand data beats second-hand opinion. Field research before every major call.
One principal contradiction at a time.
Rank problems; solving the top one dissolves several others.
Prepare for the worst, strive for the best.
Plan from the worst case so surprises never become disasters.
Enemy advances, we retreat; enemy halts, we harass; enemy tires, we strike; enemy retreats, we pursue.
The weak side wins by controlling tempo, not by matching strength.
Rehearse and calculate before committing; win the battle before fighting it.
Each stage has its own strategy — what worked yesterday may fail tomorrow.
Core capabilities must be independent of others; alliances supplement, never substitute.
From the masses, to the masses.
Information and morale flow both ways with the people you work with — listen, then lead.
Preserve yourself to destroy the enemy.
Survival is the precondition of victory — never trade existence for a point.
Win over the many, isolate the few.
Split your opponents; fight one principal enemy at a time.

你要知道梨子的滋味,你就得变革梨子,亲口吃一吃。
If you want to know the taste of a pear, you must change the pear by eating it yourself.
实践、认识、再实践、再认识,这种形式,循环往复以至无穷。
Practice, knowledge, again practice, and again knowledge. This form repeats itself in endless cycles.
事物的矛盾法则,即对立统一的法则,是唯物辩证法的最根本的法则。
The law of contradiction in things, that is, the law of the unity of opposites, is the fundamental law of materialist dialectics.
敌进我退,敌驻我扰,敌疲我打,敌退我追。
The enemy advances, we retreat; the enemy camps, we harass; the enemy tires, we attack; the enemy retreats, we pursue.
《中国革命战争的战略问题》(1936) · Problems of Strategy in China\'s Revolutionary War
对于人,伤其十指不如断其一指;对于敌,击溃其十个师不如歼灭其一个师。
Injuring all of a man\'s ten fingers is not as effective as chopping off one; and routing ten enemy divisions is not as effective as annihilating one of them.
《中国革命战争的战略问题》(1936) · Problems of Strategy in China\'s Revolutionary War
战争的伟力之最深厚的根源,存在于民众之中。
The richest source of power to wage war lies in the masses of the people.
The army and the people are the foundation of victory.
墙上芦苇,头重脚轻根底浅;山间竹笋,嘴尖皮厚腹中空。
The reed growing on the wall — top-heavy, thin-stemmed and shallow of root; the bamboo shoot in the hills — sharp-tongued, thick-skinned and hollow inside.
《改造我们的学习》(1941) · Reform Our Study
到什么山上唱什么歌。……我们无论做什么事都要看情形办理。
Sing different songs on different mountains. … Whatever we do, we must act according to the circumstances.
《反对党八股》(1942) · Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing
人固有一死,或重于泰山,或轻于鸿毛。
All men must die, but death can be weightier than Mount Tai or lighter than a feather. (quoting Sima Qian)
在战略上我们要藐视一切敌人,在战术上我们要重视一切敌人。
Strategically we should despise all our enemies, but tactically we should take them all seriously.
《关于目前党的政策中的几个重要问题》(1948) · On Some Important Problems of the Party\'s Present Policy
下定决心,不怕牺牲,排除万难,去争取胜利。
Be resolute, fear no sacrifice and surmount every difficulty to win victory.
《愚公移山》(1945) · The Foolish Old Man Who Removed the Mountains
